title: Too good to be true
body: I have tried multiple routine apps and this is by far the best one. At first I thought I had to pay for some subscription at some point but no. I wish i had found this app sooner. I never write reviews but i just had to with this app
author: Telts1107

body: Compared to similar apps, this one is the best in its field. I believe this because, with its help, I wake up feeling more alert in the morning and fall asleep faster at night. It is also excellent because the free version offers so many features you can customize and add without paying a thing. I recommend it to anyone striving to achieve something greater in life.
author: MemmImelda
